inputs.text: Vertical medium close shot of the same adult Chinese woman seated at the wooden desk. She holds one portrait-oriented smartphone steadily at chest height with its matte rear shell and camera module facing the camera; the display faces her and is completely hidden. She suddenly notices a new incoming call, expressed only through her widened eyes and a slight lift of her chin. Her free hand rests beside the laptop. Same oval face, low ponytail, light blue shirt, charcoal blazer and thin silver necklace. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll film, cool blue light beginning to warm. Exactly one woman and one phone, rear side only, no visible screen, no interface, no generated text. Animate only the following controlled action. Start: she holds one phone steadily at chest height with its rear shell facing the camera and looks at the hidden display. Action: the phone stays in exactly the same position; only her eyes widen, her chin lifts slightly, and her free hand pulls back by two centimeters. End: she remains frozen in surprised attention, still showing only the phone back. Motion is extremely small and slow; no phone exit, re-entry, rotation, or tapping. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. No dialogue or lip movement.
